q: At a fashion show, organizers extended the runway so models could walk farther in front of the audience. What did they change?
o: The catwalk used by models was made longer.
A strip for aircraft take-offs was added.
The standards for judging body shape were rewritten.
The audience seating was rearranged around the stage.

exp.trans: 时装秀主办方延长了runway，让模特能在观众面前走得更远。这里改变的是模特走秀的T台长度。
exp.structure: At a fashion show限定场景；organizers是主语，extended是谓语，the runway是宾语；so引导结果状语。
exp.other: runway在时装秀语境中是T台；catwalk走秀台；aircraft take-off飞机起飞；body shape体形。
exp.meaning: runway有机场跑道义，也有时装秀T台义。词义由fashion show、models和audience共同限定。原题B抓住runways这一局部词形，却把时装展示语境改成机场基础设施。
exp.rest: B把T台换成飞机起降设施；C把延长T台改成修改审美标准；D改动观众席，与句中明确延长runway不符。

skill: 抽象名词在评价语境中的含义
q: At a national design competition, the jury served as the final arbiters of which proposals would receive the award. Here, arbiters are people who:
o: make the final decision about what is accepted
prepare the proposals for public display
provide funding to the designers on the shortlist
record the audience's reactions after the award

exp.trans: 在全国设计竞赛中，评审团是决定哪些方案获奖的最终裁定者。arbiters指作出最终判断的人。
exp.structure: the jury是主语，served as是谓语，the final arbiters是主语补足语；of which proposals说明裁定对象。
exp.other: arbiter裁定者、评判者；jury评审团；proposal提案；shortlist入围名单。
exp.meaning: arbiter强调有权作出判断或裁定的人，不是负责准备材料、提供资金或记录反馈的人。
exp.rest: 准备展品、提供资金和记录观众反应都是竞赛中的其他工作，不等于决定哪些方案获奖。

target: is trying to establish / would be introduced
q: An engineering association is trying to establish voluntary safety standards for battery repairs. Its report says common standards would be introduced if enough workshops joined the pilot. Which interpretation is supported?
o: The standards are being pursued, but are not yet in force.
The standards are already operating in every workshop.
The association has stopped pursuing the proposed standards.
The workshops finished drafting the standards before the pilot.

exp.trans: 一个工程协会正在尝试为电池维修制定自愿性安全标准。报告说，如果有足够多的维修点参加试点，就会引入统一标准。
exp.structure: is trying to establish是现在进行时，表示当前正在尝试；would be introduced是情态动词加被动语态，if从句给出条件。
exp.other: voluntary自愿的；standard标准；pilot试点；in force生效。
exp.meaning: is trying to establish说明制定工作正在推进；would be introduced说明预期/条件下将引入，并不表示已经完成。必须区分尝试、预期结果和已经生效。
exp.rest: B把预期结果升级成已经在所有维修点生效；C把正在推进改成停止；D把标准完成时间倒置到试点开始之前。

target: would be adopted if / 条件结果
skill: 条件性将来与完成状态
q: After a trial, a hospital report says a shared handover checklist would be adopted if staff approved the plan. Which statement is accurate?
o: The checklist is already used across every hospital ward.
Adoption depends on staff approval and is not yet complete.
The hospital cancelled the checklist after the trial.
Staff approved the checklist before the plan was first proposed.

exp.trans: 试点结束后，医院报告说，如果员工批准方案，就会采用统一的交接清单。是否采用仍取决于员工批准，并非已经完成。
exp.structure: would be adopted是情态动词加被动结构；if staff approved the plan是条件从句。
exp.meaning: would be adopted if...表示条件满足时预期采用，不能据此说已经在所有病区使用。
exp.rest: A把条件性计划说成全面实施；C说医院取消方案；D把员工批准提前到方案提出之前。

skill: 标准、违规原因与执行机制
q: A fashion-industry code lists models' age, health and other characteristics. It is enforced by denying designers and agencies access to a major show when they breach the code. Which statement separates the standard from the enforcement measure?
o: Age, health and other characteristics are criteria; exclusion is the sanction.
Models' character and personality are criteria; exclusion is the sanction.
Age, health and other characteristics are sanctions; exclusion is the criterion.
Designers' character is assessed; exclusion is a model health criterion.

exp.trans: 时尚行业守则列出模特的年龄、健康状况及其他特征；违反守则时，执行方式是拒绝设计师和经纪公司进入时装秀。
exp.structure: lists的宾语是models' age, health and other characteristics；is enforced by说明执行手段；when引导违规条件。
exp.other: character性格、品格；characteristics特征、特点；criteria标准；sanction制裁；exclusion拒绝进入。
exp.meaning: character与characteristics不同：前者指性格/品格，后者指特征。规则内容、违规原因和执行机制是不同层次。
exp.rest: B把性格当作规则标准；C把标准与制裁倒置；D把设计师性格和模特健康标准错配。

skill: 要求与执行工具的角色区分
q: A laboratory safety code requires eye protection and ventilation checks. After repeated breaches, a manager suspends staff badge access to enforce it. Which pair identifies the rule and the enforcement mechanism?
o: Eye protection and ventilation are rules; badge suspension enforces them.
Badge suspension is a rule; eye protection is the tool used to enforce it.
Both are penalties imposed after an inspection and repeated violations.
Both are personal traits expected of technicians during laboratory work.

exp.trans: 实验室安全守则要求佩戴护目镜并检查通风；多次违规后，经理暂停员工门禁卡权限来执行守则。
exp.structure: code是主语，requires是谓语；manager suspends...是后续执行动作，to enforce it表示目的。
exp.other: eye protection眼部防护；ventilation通风；breach违规；badge access门禁权限；suspend暂停。
exp.meaning: 规则说明必须做什么，执行机制说明违反规则后如何处理。
exp.rest: B颠倒规则与执行手段；C把要求和处罚都说成处罚；D把制度要求误写成个人性格特征。

target: title coverage / 核心争议对象
q: At a university, hiring panels have long treated publication counts and institutional prestige as the main signs of academic merit. A new proposal gives more weight to teaching, mentoring and contributions to local research groups. Critics argue that the old measures overlook important work, especially by early-career scholars. Which title best captures the central issue?
o: A Challenge to Universities' Ideas of Academic Merit
Another Debate About Competition in Higher Education
Why Young Scholars Are Leaving University Research
A New Ranking System for Research Universities

exp.trans: 大学招聘长期把论文数量和机构声望当作学术价值的主要标志。新方案提高教学、指导学生和本地研究贡献的权重，批评者认为旧标准忽略重要工作。核心是挑战大学对学术价值的既有定义。
exp.structure: 首句交代既有评价标准；第二句提出新方案；第三句由Critics argue引出中心批评。
exp.other: publication count论文数量；institutional prestige机构声望；academic merit学术价值；early-career scholar职业早期学者。
exp.meaning: A覆盖被挑战的主体（大学）和争议对象（学术价值标准），而不是只摘取一个局部案例。
exp.rest: B只说高等教育竞争，范围过宽；C声称年轻学者正在离开研究岗位，原文没有此事实；D把新评价方案误写成已经建立的新排名系统。

q: A city library has been judged mainly by the number of books borrowed. A new review argues that this measure misses digital help, language classes, and access for residents who cannot visit during the day. It asks the city to reconsider what a successful library provides. Which title best represents the argument?
o: Rethinking How Cities Measure Library Success
Why Borrowing Books Has Declined in City Libraries
A Plan to Replace Libraries with Online Services
The Growing Cost of Running Public Libraries

exp.trans: 一座城市图书馆过去主要按借阅量评价。新评估指出，这一指标忽略数字服务、语言课程以及白天无法到馆居民的使用机会，因而要求重新思考什么才算图书馆成功。
exp.structure: 首句给出旧指标；第二句指出其遗漏；第三句概括中心诉求。
exp.other: borrow借阅；digital help数字服务；access使用机会/可及性；measure衡量指标。
exp.meaning: 核心不是借阅量下降、线上服务取代图书馆或运营成本，而是成功标准需要重新衡量。
exp.rest: B说借阅量下降，原文没有报告趋势；C说用线上服务取代图书馆，超出原文；D把成本当成核心问题。
